senses.gloss: m. (= קבקב׳; cmp. קוֹבַע, כּוֹבַע) the thick muscular stomach of birds, craw.
units: Ib. 6 (among the characteristics of clean birds) קוֹרְקְבָנוֹ נקלף whose craw peels easily; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 22; Ḥull. 61ᵃ וקוּרְקְבָנָן נקלף (not וקורקבן); Yalk. Lev. 537 וקרקבנו (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. קָרְקְבָנִין (with sing. meaning). Tosef. l. c. 16 באלו … אמרו בק׳ וכ׳ by these intestines are meant: the craw, the liver, and the heart. Sifra Vayiḳra, N’dabah, ch. VIII, Par. 7.—In gen. stomach (= הֶמְסֵס).
<cite ref="Berakhot 61b:1">Ber. 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>ק׳ טוחן</he> the stomach (of man) grinds.
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:8">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 12:4">Koh. XII, 4</cite>) <he>בשביל ק׳ שאינו טוחן</he> on account of the stomach’s failing to grind.
